details: All six automatic roles: size0 capture -> size4 report; size4 capture -> size0/milked6 report; size2/milked1 capture -> size3/milked6 report.
Every automatic report checks captured gain, percent, exact approved prose, no inventory topup, and no second tally when the cleared flag is read again.
Legacy missing cache: old base18, bonus0, exact ordinary current text, no inventory topup, no repeated tally.
Manual cached dynslave success source is replaced into slave and assistant using production $replace mechanism.
All three manual special literals are checked exactly at each size0..4.
Production clear statements and production existing storage cap statement are executed.
